negative_probes.location: TEMP only (mktemp directory, deleted after run)

findings.title: strict loader does not reject numeric-overflow non-finites
findings.detail: strict_loads rejects duplicate keys and NaN/Infinity/-Infinity constants, but Python's JSON decoder turns overflow literals such as 1e400 into float('inf') without invoking parse_constant. Non-finite could enter an un-type-checked float field.
findings.impact: low: all asserted numeric fields are exact-type-checked int and both originals are SHA256-pinned, so affected paths fail closed

findings.title: two redundant structure fields left unreconciled (informational)
findings.detail: structure.rate_unmet is not cross-checked against structure.probe_outcomes.rate_unmet, and structure.rate_timing_probe is not cross-checked against probe_phases.sample_count. Both are consistent in the pinned original.
findings.impact: none: coverage widening only, no fail-closed gap

scope_limitations: static review of the candidate and the two pinned originals only
single unittest command plus TEMP-only pure negative probes of the test's own helpers
no #83 execution and no native/build/runtime/WSL/MATLAB/ROS/DDS/SITL/FC/UE/flight commands run
no source, test, or original file edited; no git staging/commit/push/reset/clean performed
arithmetic reconciled from recorded values only; no analyzer or runtime re-execution
verifies test correctness against pinned originals, not the diagnostic analysis content itself

verdict.rule: PASS only if no P1/P2 findings
